<thought>Based on the observed isotopic envelope, the strong M+2 peak at ~33 % of the monoisotopic intensity matches the characteristic 3:1 (M : M+2) pattern of chlorine. The progressive M+1 intensity (~16 %) aligns with the expected C‑13 contribution from a molecule containing many carbons. These two elements have distinctive isotope patterns that can be identified unambiguously from the spectrum.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
